report.impact: -7.4 days on New-deal cycle (90% range -10.2 to -4.6); first response -5.1 h
report.method: Difference-in-differences: staggered rollout (EMEA Apr, NA East Jul) vs teams without it, team and close-month fixed effects
report.decision: Renew, then expand to NA West and LATAM in waves

report.name: Meeting-prep assistant
report.impact: -3.2 days per brief after controls (raw gap -9.6 days overstates it)
report.method: Record-level with team, month, SDR and SE controls; usage dose by team
report.decision: Renew; lift adoption in APAC and LATAM

report.name: Deal-summary bots (EMEA and NA East builds)
report.impact: -0.5 days (90% range -1.6 to 0.8): no measurable effect
report.note: Flagged as parallel in week 1 of the second build. Built twice: 63 engineer-days ($44K) of build effort on top of run cost

report.name: ChatGPT Enterprise · coding
report.impact: Built and now maintains both deal-summary bots (228 build, 208 maintenance sessions) and 1 unregistered tool; 3 scripts rewritten in all five teams; the bots show no effect
report.method: Lineage: sessions linked to repo commits by team, timing and text -> CI deploy -> CRM records
report.decision: Keep coding use; share the repeated scripts; watch for parallel builds weekly

report.name: ChatGPT Enterprise · other tasks
report.impact: -2.2 days on the 103 deals its sessions link to (90% range -3.5 to -0.7); active seats fell from 100% to 40%; 97% of sessions link to no deal
report.method: Record level: sessions linked to deals by account, timing and text; controls for team, month, type, AI SDR, prep, SE
report.decision: Keep the seats used on live deals; right-size the rest at renewal
